info.name: PhonePe PG Chargeback (Disputes)
info.description:
PhonePe Payment Gateway - Chargeback / Dispute Management APIs.

Introduction: A chargeback is a dispute raised by a customer against a transaction (undelivered goods, poor experience, suspected fraud, etc.). These APIs let you track and respond to disputes: fetch a single dispute, list disputes over a date range, accept a dispute, contest it, and manage supporting evidence.

Folders:
- Authorization -> Get Access Token
- Disputes -> Fetch Dispute, Fetch List of Disputes, Accept Dispute, Contest Dispute
- Evidence -> Upload Evidence, Delete Evidence
- Webhooks (Mock Server) -> dispute lifecycle callbacks

Credentials: set client_id, client_version, client_secret and tsp_env in the environment; the access token is fetched/refreshed automatically. Set dispute_id (and evidence_id) to target a specific dispute.

Environments:
- Sandbox: https://api-preprod.phonepe.com/apis/pg-sandbox/<Endpoint>
- Production: Authorization API https://api.phonepe.com/apis/identity-manager/<Endpoint> ; Other APIs https://api.phonepe.com/apis/pg/<Endpoint>

API Endpoints:
- Authorization          POST   /v1/oauth/token
- Fetch Dispute          GET    /v1/disputes/{disputeId}
- Fetch List of Disputes GET    /v1/disputes?from&to&offset&limit&status
- Accept Dispute         POST   /v1/disputes/{disputeId}/accept
- Contest Dispute        POST   /v1/disputes/{disputeId}/contest
- Upload Evidence        POST   /v1/disputes/{disputeId}/evidences
- Delete Evidence        DELETE /v1/disputes/{disputeId}/evidences/{evidenceId}

Note: For Partner integrations, add an X-MERCHANT-ID header with the end merchant's MerchantID on every call.

Docs:
- Introduction: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/
- Authorization: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/authorization
- Fetch Dispute: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/fetch-dispute
- Fetch List of Disputes: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/fetch-list-of-disputes
- Accept Dispute: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/accept-dispute
- Contest Dispute: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/contest-dispute
- Upload Evidence: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/upload-evidence
- Delete Evidence: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/delete-evidence
- Webhook: https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/webhook-handling

exec: throw new Error('Missing access_token. Run Authorization/Get Access Token first.');

request.description: Generate the O-Bearer access token required to authenticate all Chargeback API requests. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/authorization
Retrieve the details of a single dispute by disputeId. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/fetch-dispute

List disputes over a date range. from/to are epoch-millisecond timestamps (both REQUIRED; auto-defaulted by the pre-request script to the last 30 days, and from must be < to). offset/limit paginate (limit max 100). status is REQUIRED - one of ACTION_REQUIRED, UNDER_REVIEW, WON, LOST. Response has disputes[], nextOffset, totalCount. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/fetch-list-of-disputes

exec: // Auto-fill a last-30-days window if not already set (edit these variables to change the range)

request.description: Accept the chargeback raised by the customer (no request body - only the disputeId path param). A dispute can be accepted only when its status is ACTION_REQUIRED, otherwise a 409 INVALID_TRANSITION is returned. Response returns the dispute object with status UNDER_REVIEW. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/accept-dispute

Contest (challenge) the chargeback if you believe it is invalid. Upload supporting evidence first via Upload Evidence. Body: type (FULL_CONTEST | PARTIAL_CONTEST) and contestAmount (paise, > 0 and <= dispute amount). Can only be contested when status is ACTION_REQUIRED. Response returns the dispute object with status UNDER_REVIEW. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/contest-dispute

formdata.description: Select the supporting document to upload here (max 2 MB, non-empty; allowed types: bmp, jpeg, jpg, pdf, csv, doc, png)
Evidence type: explanationLetter | customerRecallLetter | serviceConfirmation | refundConfirmation | serviceCancellation | deliveryProof | shippingProof | accessActivityLog
Display name of the file (required, max 256 chars)

request.description: Submit supporting documents to strengthen your case when contesting a dispute. multipart/form-data fields: file (max 2 MB, allowed bmp/jpeg/jpg/pdf/csv/doc/png), type (evidence type enum), label (file name, max 256). Evidence can be uploaded only when the dispute is ACTION_REQUIRED. Response returns evidenceId + label. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/upload-evidence

Delete a previously uploaded evidence file by disputeId + evidenceId. Only allowed while the dispute is ACTION_REQUIRED. Response: { success: true }. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/delete-evidence

item.name: Webhooks (Mock Server)
item.description: Sample PhonePe dispute callbacks. Configure the real webhook (URL + username/password + events) in the PhonePe Business Dashboard -> Developer Settings -> Webhook. PhonePe signs each callback with an Authorization header = SHA256(username:password). Right-click this folder -> Mock Collection to create a Postman mock server, then set mock_base_url to the generated URL and webhook_auth_sha256 to your SHA256(username:password). Dispute events: payment.dispute.created, payment.dispute.action_required, payment.dispute.under_review, payment.dispute.won, payment.dispute.lost. https://developer.phonepe.com/chargeback/webhook-handling

request.description: Sample dispute lifecycle callback. When payment.dispute.created is sent the status is UNDER_REVIEW; if the dispute is valid a follow-up payment.dispute.action_required (status ACTION_REQUIRED) is sent.
